title: Where Is the Verse? Benchmark, labels, embeddings and reconstruction scripts for Canonical Verse Grounding (GitaGround release)
description: Route (a) release. Contains the lecture catalogue, verse-theme file, passage grid (offsets and hashes, no text), gold labels, second-pass labels and adjudication, all LLM labels, embeddings and features, frozen system files, the experiment log, and a reconstruct/ folder with source URLs and the ASR, segmentation and alignment scripts. Lecture audio and transcript text are not distributed. Code: MIT. Labels and data: CC BY-NC 4.0.
